context_for_next_testing_agent: Backfill of master_sessions.video_duration_minutes is complete: 59/59 sessions with lecture_url now have real MP4-derived durations. Formula in /app/frontend/src/utils/sessionTime.js is effectiveMinutes = round(video_duration_minutes || 15) + 10. Sessions with no lecture_url still show 25min — that's by design. If the product team wants those sessions to appear differently (e.g., 'TBD' or hidden pill), that would be a separate feature, not a bug.
rca of the issue: Root cause was data-only: master_sessions.video_duration_minutes column was added by migration 0041 but never backfilled for the 59 existing lecture videos, so all rows had NULL. The frontend formula round(NULL||15)+10 collapsed every session to 25min. Fix applied by main agent: /app/scripts/backfill_video_durations.py parsed each MP4's mvhd atom via HTTP range requests and PATCHed real durations into Supabase (ok=59 fail=0). Verified end-to-end: DB rows populated with 3.91–36.48 min values, frontend now displays varied durations and correct module totals.
